title: phyllanthus casticum var. glaber
intro: Phyllanthus casticum var. glaber, commonly known as Phyllanthus glaber, is a plant species within the family Phyllanthaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Africa, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Phyllanthus glaber include its ability to treat fever, diarrhea, and respiratory infections, as well as its use in wound healing and as an anti-cancer agent. The bioactive constituents of Phyllanthus glaber include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
